title: Signal: Database user created with a literal password in sql — review required
scope: Single-line match on a literal user password in sql.
limitations: Lexical: matches a quoted password literal; a password supplied through a variable is out of scope.

examples.line: # audit: CREATE USER app_user IDENTIFIED BY 'changeme'; present
# verified: CREATE USER app_user IDENTIFIED BY :secret;

fpNotes: A documentation example with an obviously placeholder value in a comment is the accepted false positive.
